source_text: Rebuttals emphasize that the three pivotal RCTs (in South Africa, Kenya, and Uganda) demonstrated consistent 50-60% reduction in HIV acquisition among heterosexual men, with pooled analyses confirming biological causality via mechanisms like reduced viral entry through the foreskin.
